result.journal: International Journal of Circuit Theory and Applications
result.keywords: SummaryIn this paper, a hybrid multiport dc-dc converter is proposed for renewable-energy and microgrid interfaces. The topology combines high step-up gain with continuous input current and zero-voltage switching for the main switches. It can interface three dc sources and deliver regulated output under boost and buck-boost modes. The operating principles are analyzed in detail, including steady-state equations, soft-switching conditions, and ripple reduction characteristics. Simulation and experimental results are presented to validate the converter performance in distributed generation applications.
result.title: Hybrid multiport high step-up dc-dc converter with continuous input current and soft-switching operation
